-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.ConfPolicy` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem policyRec_timeless (γ : Cluster) (r : ConfRule) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : Timeless
    (policyRec γ r k d)

theorem confPolicy_decide [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N N' : Namespace) (E : CoPset)
    (r : ConfRule) (l : List LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (m m' : Membership) : l[k]? = some e
    → e.isConfChange → ↑N' ⊆ E → (ConfDecision.ofRule (r (List.take k l) m e)).step m = some m' → ⊢
    isCluster γ N ∗ confPolicy γ N' r ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ={E}=∗ confDecided γ k
    (ConfDecision.ofRule (r (List.take k l) m e))

theorem confPolicy_persistent (γ : Cluster) (N' : Namespace) (r : ConfRule) : Persistent (confPolicy
    γ N' r)

def (sealed) confPolicy (γ : Cluster) (N' : Namespace) (r : ConfRule) : IProp GF

def policyRec (γ : Cluster) (r : ConfRule) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l e m, isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ∗ ⌜l[k]? = some e ∧ d = ConfDecision.ofRule (r (List.take k l) m e)⌝)

def confPolicyBody (γ : Cluster) (r : ConfRule) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ D, ownConfDecisions γ D ∗ □ ∀ k d, ⌜D !! k = some d⌝ -∗ policyRec γ r k d)

theorem confPolicy_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N' : Namespace) (r : ConfRule)
    (E : CoPset) : ⊢ ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ={E}=∗ confPolicy γ N' r

theorem policyRec_persistent (γ : Cluster) (r : ConfRule) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : Persistent
    (policyRec γ r k d)
